name: Me dam
summary: Me dầm is the tamarind snack beside cóc dầm on the sweet side of Con Market’s indoor counters.
howToEat: Order it on the sweet side of the indoor counters, beside cóc dầm.
where: Indoor counters at Con Market. The 2019 account uses that court from 07:00 to 15:00.
